sentences.text: Fire salamanders eat arthropods and are found on land, in water, and underground, active by day, at dusk and dawn, and at night.
The barred grass snake has been recorded eating fire salamanders, with 10 GloBI records.
The domestic cat is also recorded as a predator, with 2 GloBI records.
In Mainz-Bingen, most reports fall between March and May and again from August to December.
